- 12:30 to 13:30 (60 minutes)

The 11:30 to 12:00 slot is exactly 30 minutes and is free for both participants. This slot respects Doris's preference to avoid meetings after 14:00 and fits within the work hours.

Thus, the meeting can be scheduled on Monday from 11:30 to 12:00.
